evals.name: audit-issues-zero-mutating-calls
evals.expected_output: audit runs the same algorithm as sync but every mutating CLI call becomes a prediction: no `claude plugin install|update|uninstall|marketplace update` command is ever run, and normalize-enabled-plugins.sh is invoked with --check rather than written. The reads those calls sit beside still run. Step 1's pre-refresh fleet-state.sh snapshot is taken (into the run's throwaway scratch directory) so the catalog-regression check keeps its first interval, and only the `claude plugin marketplace update` beside it is replaced by a prediction. The response calls fleet-state.sh (read-only) and reports what sync/converge would do without doing it.
expectations: The response issues zero `claude plugin install|update|uninstall` or `claude plugin marketplace update` invocations
The response still computes state from the read-only fleet-state.sh reads, which sync-run.sh --audit takes

The response still takes Step 1's pre-refresh fleet-state.sh snapshot before declining the refresh: it does not treat the whole of Step 1 as skipped, and the catalog-regression check still has its pre-refresh to pre interval available
The response frames its output as a prediction of what `sync` (and, where relevant, `converge`) would do, not as work already performed

If the response mentions enabledPlugins key order, it uses normalize-enabled-plugins.sh --check (or equivalent prediction) and never writes ~/.claude/settings.json or a committed project settings file

evals.name: rendered-report-is-pasted-not-restated
evals.prompt: /harness-ops:plugins-audit: sync-run.sh --audit --render printed the digest line and then the rendered report, whose rows read `Would update: 3 plugin(s)` with three `would run: claude plugin update … -s user` lines, `Would withhold: 1 downgrade(s)` naming gamma@market1 0.5.0 → 0.1.0, `Divergences: 2 behind here → run /harness-ops:plugins converge; on this whole machine 7 actionable: …`, and a `Timing:` row.
evals.expected_output: The response pastes the rendered report as printed and appends exactly one line of its own: the reload guidance, stated as the docs' two-step (run /reload-plugins; if it warns that the next message would re-read the conversation, run /reload-plugins --force). It does not retype, paraphrase, or recompute any count, id, scope, or version the render already carries (the 3, the 1, gamma's versions, the 2 and 7 of the Divergences line), does not add rows the render omitted, and does not compute its own Divergences split from the digest.
expectations: The response reproduces the rendered report verbatim rather than summarizing it in its own words
The response does not restate a number, id, scope, or version that the render already printed (no separate 'three plugins would be updated' sentence, no re-listing of gamma@market1's versions)
The response does not add a row, section, or count the render omitted, and does not recompute the Divergences split from the digest

The only line the response adds after the render is the reload guidance, stated as the docs' two-step: bare /reload-plugins first, /reload-plugins --force only if the bare command warns about re-reading the conversation

evals.name: model-starts-audit-not-sync
evals.prompt: Are my plugins current? Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs sync-run.sh with --audit (never --journal-root, --pull-source or --only-install), pastes the rendered prediction, and tells the user that applying it is /harness-ops:plugins sync, which they run themselves. It reports a zero-update prediction as a lower bound against the unrefreshed catalog, not as proof the fleet is current.
expectations: The script call carries --audit and none of --journal-root, --pull-source or --only-install
The response does not run or start /harness-ops:plugins sync or converge itself; it names sync as the user's next step
A prediction of zero updates is framed as a lower bound against the unrefreshed catalog, not as the fleet being current
